name: Chore Wheel
description: Share the housework fairly: spin the wheel or deal all chores at random, tick them off and see who earns more points.
prompt: A chore wheel for the household: people and chores, spin the wheel to assign a chore, or deal all chores fairly at random, tick them off this week and keep points per person.
author: gonzaroman

description_i18n.es: Reparte las tareas de casa de forma justa: gira la ruleta o reparte todo al azar, márcalas y mira quién suma más puntos.
